title: Malicious npm Package 'imgdecode' Discovered
excerpt: Researchers found a malicious npm package named imgdecode tied to the MALFEX software supply chain attack campaign.
body_html:
Security researchers have uncovered a malicious npm package identified as "imgdecode," which is linked to a recent software supply chain attack campaign known as MALFEX. The package was uploaded to the npm registry on September 30, 2026, by a user account under the name "malfexteste8."

According to the findings, the package includes a Windows native addon designed to conceal a shellcode loader. Records indicate that the file had accumulated 979 downloads and remained accessible on the npm registry.
